22
Ahasia nnisoɔ ne ne wuo
1 # 2 Ah 8.25-29 Na Yerusalemfoɔ de ne ba kumaa Ahasia sii hene n’ananmu, ɛfiri sɛ ne mma mpanimfoɔ no nyinaa, afomfafoɔ asafo a wɔne Arabfoɔ no baa nsra mu no kunkumm wɔn. Na Yehoram ba Ahasia dii Yuda hene. 2Ahasia dii mfeɛ aduanan mmienu na ɔbɛdii hene, na ɔdii hene afe baako wɔ Yerusalem. Na ne na din de Atalia a ɔyɛ Omri ba. 3Ɔno nso nantee Ahab fie akwan so, ɛfiri sɛ ne na tuu no fo sɛ ɔnni asɛmmɔne. 4Na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne sɛ Ahab fie, ɛfiri sɛ n’agya wuo akyiri no wɔn na wɔtuu no foɔ, na ɛmaa no guu asu. 5Wɔn afotuo nso so na ɔnam kɔeɛ, na ɔne Israelhene Yehoram a ɔyɛ Ahab ba kɔɔ ɔsa ne Siriahene Hasael kɔkoe wɔ Ramot-gilead. Na Siriafoɔ no piraa Yehoram. 6Na ɔsanee sɛ ɔrekɔsa ne ho yadeɛ Yesreel afiri pira a ɔne Siriahene Hasael reko no, wɔpirapiraa no Rama no mu. Na Yudahene Yehoram ba Asaria siane kɔɔ sɛ ɔrekɔhwɛ Ahab ba Yehoram Yesreel, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔyare.
7 # 1 Ah 19.16; 2 Ah 9.6 Na Onyankopɔn na ɔde asiane bɛsianee Ahasia sɛ ɔnkɔ Yehoram nkyɛn. Na ɔduruiɛ no, ɔne Yehoram fie kɔhyiaa Nimsi ba Yehu a AWURADE asra no sɛ ɔnsɛe Ahab fie. 8#2 Ah 10.12-14 Na Yehu rebu Ahab fie atɛn no, ɔkɔtoo Yuda mmapɔmma ne Ahasia nuanom mma a wɔsom Ahasia no, na ɔkunkumm wɔn. 9#2 Ah 9.27-29 Na ɔkɔhwehwɛɛ Ahasia, na wɔkyeree no, na ɔno deɛ, na ɔde ne ho ahunta Samaria. Na wɔde no brɛɛ Yehu, na wɔkumm no. Na wɔsiee no, na wɔkaa sɛ: Yehosafat a ɔde n’akoma nyinaa hwehwɛɛ AWURADE no ba ne no. Na obiara nni Ahasia fie bio a ɔbɛnya ahennie no ho ahoɔden.
Atalia awudie
10 # 2 Ah 11.1-3 Na Ahasia na Atalia hunuu sɛ ne ba awuo no, ɔsɔre kɔdwerɛɛ adehyeɛ a wɔwɔ Yuda fie nyinaa. 11Na ɔhene babaa Yehosabat faa Ahasia ba Yoas, na ɔwiaa no firii ɔhene mma a wɔreku wɔn no mu, na ɔde no ne ne ɔbagyegyefoɔ hyɛɛ pia mu. Na sɛ Ɔhene Yehoram babaa Yehosabat a ɔyɛ Ɔsɔfoɔ Yehoiada yere no yɛ Ahasia nuabaa nti, ɔde no hunta firii Atalia anim, na wanku no. 12Na ɔne wɔn tenaa Nyankopɔn fie, huntaa mfeɛ nsia. Na Atalia dii asase no so hemmaa.

Na Yerusalemfoɔ de ne ba kumaa Ahasia sii hene n’ananmu, ɛfiri sɛ ne mma mpanimfoɔ no nyinaa, afomfafoɔ asafo a wɔne Arabfoɔ no baa nsra mu no kunkumm wɔn. Na Yehoram ba Ahasia dii Yuda hene. Ahasia dii mfeɛ aduanan mmienu na ɔbɛdii hene, na ɔdii hene afe baako wɔ Yerusalem. Na ne na din de Atalia a ɔyɛ Omri ba. Ɔno nso nantee Ahab fie akwan so, ɛfiri sɛ ne na tuu no fo sɛ ɔnni asɛmmɔne. Na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne sɛ Ahab fie, ɛfiri sɛ n’agya wuo akyiri no wɔn na wɔtuu no foɔ, na ɛmaa no guu asu. Wɔn afotuo nso so na ɔnam kɔeɛ, na ɔne Israelhene Yehoram a ɔyɛ Ahab ba kɔɔ ɔsa ne Siriahene Hasael kɔkoe wɔ Ramot-gilead. Na Siriafoɔ no piraa Yehoram. Na ɔsanee sɛ ɔrekɔsa ne ho yadeɛ Yesreel afiri pira a ɔne Siriahene Hasael reko no, wɔpirapiraa no Rama no mu. Na Yudahene Yehoram ba Asaria siane kɔɔ sɛ ɔrekɔhwɛ Ahab ba Yehoram Yesreel, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔyare.
Na Onyankopɔn na ɔde asiane bɛsianee Ahasia sɛ ɔnkɔ Yehoram nkyɛn. Na ɔduruiɛ no, ɔne Yehoram fie kɔhyiaa Nimsi ba Yehu a AWURADE asra no sɛ ɔnsɛe Ahab fie. Na Yehu rebu Ahab fie atɛn no, ɔkɔtoo Yuda mmapɔmma ne Ahasia nuanom mma a wɔsom Ahasia no, na ɔkunkumm wɔn. Na ɔkɔhwehwɛɛ Ahasia, na wɔkyeree no, na ɔno deɛ, na ɔde ne ho ahunta Samaria. Na wɔde no brɛɛ Yehu, na wɔkumm no. Na wɔsiee no, na wɔkaa sɛ: Yehosafat a ɔde n’akoma nyinaa hwehwɛɛ AWURADE no ba ne no. Na obiara nni Ahasia fie bio a ɔbɛnya ahennie no ho ahoɔden.

Na Ahasia na Atalia hunuu sɛ ne ba awuo no, ɔsɔre kɔdwerɛɛ adehyeɛ a wɔwɔ Yuda fie nyinaa. Na ɔhene babaa Yehosabat faa Ahasia ba Yoas, na ɔwiaa no firii ɔhene mma a wɔreku wɔn no mu, na ɔde no ne ne ɔbagyegyefoɔ hyɛɛ pia mu. Na Atalia dii asase no so hemmaa.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
